note: Sites 024, 025, 032 and 033 along about 0.5 km of Old Mingle Road, 1.3 to 1.6 miles west of Cherry Run Road, each a gravel back-in set back from the road in open hardwoods, one camping unit per site. 025 (at Lick Hollow Road, shared driveway) and 033 have the gentlest driveways; 024 is the largest but its site and driveway are graded moderate, with 12 ft of overhead clearance; 032 is a small site with a posted clearance of 10 ft. Fire rings and picnic tables, nothing else. About 8 miles of forest road from Old Turnpike Road (PA 45): Bear Run Road, Woodward Gap Road, Cherry Run Road. On 2026-11-10 ReserveAmerica showed all four as Not Available on every night checked through September 2027, with no reason posted. State forest roads are not plowed in winter, and some Bald Eagle roads need 4WD and high clearance: check the route. --Claude
summary: All four site pages re-read: open year round, prices shown ($10/$15 + $6.50), but NOT bookable on any night queried. sites.count 4 -> 3 (032 fails on its 10-ft clearance); max 50 stands (024). Imagery rendered (leaf-off, 0.7 m/px): the four pins sit 16-68 m south of the road in open deciduous woods; individual pads are not distinguishable. Pins match ReserveAmerica and DCNR GIS. 3DEP: 024 4.2 m above the road over 53 m (8%), the others under 3 m. NHD: an unnamed intermittent stream 83 m from 033; no flowline within 200 m of the others (waterbody layers timed out for 024, 025, 032).
flags: CANNOT CURRENTLY BE BOOKED ONLINE: every site of this entry showed 'Not Available' on every night queried on 2026-11-10 (Nov 17-30 2026, May 12-25 2027, Jul 14-27 2027; also Dec 15-28 2026, Mar 15-28 2027 and Sep 20-Oct 3 2027 for 025 (Mar 2027 only)), and the forest's site-list grid shows the same X ('Not avail.') while neighbouring sites (021, 027, 030, 031, 034, 064-066) are open or reserved. The same block covers 022, 029 and 041, i.e. the Paddy Mountain / Cherry Run / Old Mingle / Poe Paddy group plus Hunter Road 069-070. Owner question: keep with the dated caveat (written into the note), or hold/drop until DCNR reopens them? A call to the district would settle why.
